verdict.rationale: Airweave documents framework integrations for LlamaIndex, the Vercel AI SDK, Pipedream, Sim and Google Antigravity, plus an MCP server and CLI. Nothing in the evidence documents an integration with LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs or any other real-time voice pipeline. The ~0.5s direct vector search speaks to latency only and is not a documented voice integration, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
